title: How unusual cessations were after changes in renewal fees
subtitle: Share of placebo months with a change at least as large (lower is more unusual), two baselines
source: Federal Register of Legislation (fee regulations); IP RAPID (lens timeline)
note: A bar of zero length means no placebo month moved as much. Trade marks are read in months 1 to 12 after a change, patents in months 7 to 18, to fit how each is dated.
